senses.gloss:
रिख् रिख् (connected with rts. रिङ्ख्,
रिङ्ग्, रख्, रङ्ख्), cl. 1. P. रेखति,
&c., to go, move (so given by Vopa-deva, but by
other grammarians identified in this sense with rt.
रिङ्ख् below); cl. 6. P. (not in use, but apparently
the original form of rt. लिख्, cl. 6. लिखति, q. v.),
to scratch, scrape, write; [cf. रेखा; cf. also Gr.
ἐρείκω, ἐρέχθω.]
